explanation: Encodes Bondy's strengthening as quoted on the page: if G has more than ex(n;K_r) edges then some vertex of maximum degree has a neighbourhood with more than ex(d;K_{r-1}) edges. The extra conjunct n ≤ 2d(v) is automatic, because the average degree is already at least n/2 when e(G) > ex(n;K_4) ≥ n²/4.
